items.title: Geoff Bull Interview, 1966-05-05
items.q: it's always been a dream of mine to, to listen to Jim Robinson

ctx.x: I mean Thursday, well. So it's a weekend. Yeah. Just over a week. Uh, so why don't you tell me a little bit about that and we'll let that develop.

Yeah, well, uh, my impressions are sort of, obviously, they're different to what I had because, you know, you build up a sort of, uh, you build up a, probably a glorified impression of these things. You must. From reading books and magazines and, and New Orleans to me, uh, well the city is, uh, is more modern than I wanted it to be, if you can understand what I mean. Uh-huh. I wanted New Orleans to be, I think, now that, I mean I've realised now that it was ridiculous, but I think I wanted New Orleans to be what…
Well go ahead and we can restrict it until, you know.
